race.comment: MONEY HONEY (4) ran very well in a strong race on debut at Sandown then was put away before proving far too good for a maiden field at Casterton last time. Has further upside and expected to go close again. CZECH OUT (3) is still a maiden but was tested in stakes class last campaign, placing at Listed level two back before going off the boil in the Breeders Stakes last time. Trialling very well and has the ability. Looks hard to beat. Stablemate BARGHEST (1) looks a big danger. Started at big odds here at debut but wound up strongly to score. Has drawn well and looks a great chance to get the job done again. CHA CHING KING (2) has run well at both starts over the border. Unleashed a big finish to score maiden last time and has upside. SEND IT AGAIN (8) also wound up strongly to score maiden win when on debut last time and can measure up again. Chances don't end there.
